description: DiligenceOps: submit a job’s acceptance criteria and the delivered work’s text, metadata or both, with optional supporting evidence. The signed checklist marks each criterion addressed, missing or not met, measuring counts, sizes, durations and file formats where the delivery states them, and lists claims in the deliverable (figures, certainty, superlatives) that the supplied material does not support. POST /api/deliverable-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

acceptance_criteria.description: The job’s acceptance criteria as a list, or as text with one criterion per line or sentence.

deliverable.description: The delivered work: its text, its metadata, or both.

metadata.description: Facts about the delivery such as format, files, pages, word_count, size_bytes or languages.

text.description: The delivered text or a description of the delivered files, up to 256 KB.

evidence.description: Optional supporting material for claims the deliverable makes: test output, analytics, sources. Up to 256 KB.

name: wever_deliverable-check
title: Deliverable check
